provenance: Full private transcripts and all attempt digests are retained. Public projection contains numeric decisions, exact task identities and coverage. Source text/evidence already present in the public case package reconstructs each shared semantic digest.

selection_policy.allowed_transformation: Remove exactly one leading ```json newline (or ``` newline) and its matching trailing newline ``` after outer whitespace trimming.
selection_policy.coverage: Complete-panel availability, individually valid fields and all requested panels have separate counts. Cross-model statistics use named matched intersections.
selection_policy.numeric_contract: Exact question IDs, types, choice membership, selected maximum and raw finite probabilities. Choice mass tolerance is 0.0001, matching the original panel validator. No normalization.
selection_policy.retained_evidence: Original strict status, all attempt receipt and response digests, selected attempt and explicit extraction method remain available.
selection_order: Use the strict completed observation selected by the original runner.
If there is no strict completion, select the earliest attempt with completed transport and a whole-response JSON fence whose contents pass the identical question-ID and numeric validation.
If neither is available, retain the original runner's latest outcome and any individually valid fields from that outcome.
selection_policy.syntax_boundary: Missing braces, commas, keys or values remain invalid. There are no semantic or numeric repairs.
